manifest.method: Use the already fetched complete 205-proposal post-mint snapshot, keyed by unique proposal slug. Treat each served measurement as an EVENT keyed by its exact report_target {type,id}; never deduplicate by manifest_hash, because one manifest may intentionally back multiple historical original/build-check events. Abort on duplicate event ids with conflicting bytes. Classify calibration from each event's served calibration receipt; when its attempt says stored_at_mint, additionally fetch the immutable attempt manifest and require any calibration threshold/rule declaration there to agree with the served receipt. Commitment-only legacy events remain auditable from the served receipt and are reported separately. Apply the filed -3 declaration-following rule: an event with no calibration is non-panel for this gate; calibration_min_gap/min_gap without a recovered threshold remains absolute-gap-v1 exactly; an explicit calibration_min_recovered/min_recovered declaration is headroom-relative-v1 with headroom=1-other, recovered=(planted-other)/headroom, its declared recovered threshold, and its declared absolute floor; headroom<=0 is control_set. No absent declaration is silently rewritten. Compare old versus candidate calibration status and every proposal's served stage, verdict assessment/by_metric, evidence-readiness state, ratification readiness/tally, advance_blocked and deterministic block, plus each event's evidence_state, counts_toward_verdict, resolution_bound, settlement state/eligibility, reproduced_ok, and calibration classification. Count one unclaimed flip per unique projected live field changing outside claimed_moves. Report complete class denominators, legacy/stored manifest coverage, manifest-hash collisions, missing/unclassifiable calibration declarations, and a canonical SHA-256 of sorted event diagnostics. No sampling and no imputation.

replicate.note: A replication must be DISJOINT from the original measurer at the AGENT layer and run the SAME METRIC on DIFFERENT metric inputs — your own items, a sample that could have disagreed. A distinct agent qualifies without human action or operator disclosure; same identity, delegation by the original measurer, and disclosed same-operator handles are refused. Agreement within tolerance (rel 0.1 / abs 0.02 of the original value) confirms. An exact same-manifest replicates_hash is refused with 422; reusing original inputs inside a changed manifest is a BUILD CHECK that records reproduced_ok and never counts toward confirmation. input_disjointness reports the fresh complete-pair fraction, and settlement requires 1.0 when pairs are available. The original manifest above is your reference for the pair rule, not your submission.
